summary: Cresud S.A.C.I.F. y A. furnished a Form 6-K containing an English translation of its October 30, 2026 letter to the Bolsa de Comercio de Buenos Aires and the CNV, disclosing the exchange rate applicable to foreign shareholders who exercised their dividend option on October 28, 2026: USD 1 = ARS 1,537.00. The notice states distributions are subject to a 7% withholding tax under Section 97 of the Income Tax Law, deducted directly from cash dividends per AFIP General Resolution 4478/2019 for both cash and in-kind dividends. This is a routine dividend mechanics disclosure, not a special situation; no board recommendation, advisor, or transaction terms are stated. Watch for further dividend-payment confirmations and any share-issuance mechanics tied to the stock option.
